name: Treehouse Suite
summary: Up in the trees, with a private deck facing the valley.
description: Our most-loved room: a wooden suite built around an old tamarind tree, six metres up. A king bed faces the window and the valley; the deck has two loungers and an outdoor shower with a view of the gorges.

name: Forest Cabin
summary: A snug wooden cabin at the edge of the forest.
description: A one-room cabin of local timber, tucked between the guava trees. A queen bed under a mosquito net, a reading corner and a small veranda where the birds come for breakfast crumbs.

name: Garden Bungalow
summary: Steps from the vegetable garden, with room for three.
description: A bright bungalow opening onto the garden, with a queen bed and a single day bed. The terrace looks over the herb beds and the fruit trees that supply our kitchen.

name: Family Lodge
summary: Two bedrooms and a shared living room for families.
description: Our largest lodge: a king bedroom for parents, a second room with three single beds, and a living room with a small kitchen. The wide veranda has a hammock and a table for six.

name: Valley Villa
summary: A private villa with a plunge pool over the valley.
description: Set apart at the end of the path: two king suites, a lounge with a fireplace for cool evenings, and a plunge pool on the terrace looking straight down the Black River Gorges.
